_comment: Maps each local model name to the DeepSeek V4 tier ('flash' or 'pro') it's compared against in the DeepSeek cost-comparison feature. Matched by measured capability, not by price or product name - a model's own 'Flash'/'mini' branding does not by itself mean it belongs in the DeepSeek Flash tier. Source: the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (a composite of reasoning, knowledge, math, and coding - not a single coding-only benchmark), snapshot taken 2026-08-21. On that snapshot DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 scored 51.8 and DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 scored 53.2; any local model scoring at or above ~53 is matched to Pro, anything below is matched to Flash. Flagship models with no real DeepSeek equivalent are still matched to Pro, deliberately generous to DeepSeek rather than excluded. Re-check this mapping if the index is re-run later - scores move over time. Add a line here whenever a brand-new local model name shows up; until it's added, that model is skipped in the DeepSeek comparison (shown as not compared, not priced at zero).
